title: Menschen mit besonderen Bedürfnissen
summary: The inspiration for volume nine of the book series „Karlsruher Sportwissenschaftliche Beiträge“ came from Michaela Knoll, who served on the editorial board for many years. Her four key areas of research and teaching with social responsibility – recreational sport, para-sport, Special Olympics, and research-based teaching – form the framework for “Menschen mit besonderen Bedürfnissen”. Insights into academic projects are provided by international colleagues, students, researchers and experts.
